args.text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

Here's every Marrow Agrisupply site I can find in #central-team (it's a short channel, so this is the lot):

1. Eastbank: receiving-door import attached to ticket PD-4821. The file labels doors E1/E2 but their booking sheet uses 01/02, and that needs sorting before anyone reimports. Source: Hollis, 2026-06-09 10:46 AM.
2. Pine Crossing: the appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift. A driver arrived at 7:10 and the morning receiver wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Source: you, 2026-06-09 10:48 AM. Hollis said he'd check the shift template (10:50 AM).
3. Wichita store (probable): you mentioned an 8am check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher" right after Tobias said your Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours link. The channel doesn't actually say Wichita is a Marrow store, so please confirm. Source: you, 2025-07-02 09:21 AM.

Not included: the Tulsa hub (2025-07-02) belongs to Tansley Parcel, not Marrow. Also, the 2026-06-09 thread says three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker just read "waiting", but those stores aren't named anywhere in the channel.

I've sent Pree the list in our DM. #central-team has only two Marrow Agrisupply sites and one possible third:

1. Eastbank: Hollis's message from 2026-06-09. Ticket PD-4821 has Eastbank's receiving-door import attached, but the file calls the doors E1/E2 while their booking sheet uses 01/02. That needs fixing before anyone reimports, or it will create duplicates.
2. Pine Crossing: Pree's own message from 2026-06-09. The appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift, so a driver who arrived at 7:10 was logged on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template.
3. Wichita store (maybe): Pree's message from 2025-07-02 mentions a check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher, right after Tobias said her Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours. The channel never actually says Wichita is a Marrow store, so I asked her to confirm.

I also told her that the Tulsa hub belongs to Tansley Parcel, not Marrow. And the 2026-06-09 thread mentions three stores marked "waiting" on Marrow's rollout tracker, but none of them are named in the channel.

I checked that Pree is a member of #central-team before reading it, and that channel is the only source I used. I didn't use the brain search, because its results include channels she can't see. Nothing here needed approval: there are no money figures or outside mail.
